An '''A-type''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Some were used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a few having been stationed on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[AX-456]]. During the [[battle of AX-456]], Rebel defenders used some A-type droids as a makeshift barrier between them and the attacking [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The droid wall gave the Rebels a brief advantage, but [[Cadet Leader]] [[Kyle Katarn]] ordered his stormtroopers to use [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] to tear the droid wall apart, destroying the A-types. The defenders attempted to retreat, but they were all cut down by the remaining stormtroopers.<ref name="SotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
A-type droids first appeared in the [[1997]] novella ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', written by William C. Dietz.<ref name="SotE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>
